entries.summary: HunyuanVideo-Foley documents a multimodal diffusion system for generating Foley audio conditioned on video and text descriptions. The repository includes inference code and links to model checkpoints, with XL and XXL usage examples.
entries.selection_context: Compare the documented single-video, batch and Gradio workflows for adding sound effects to existing video. This is a video-to-audio reference, not a generic video-generation tool.
entries.limitations: Verify CUDA and Python compatibility, model-download terms and available GPU memory for the selected model and offload mode. Publisher audio-quality, synchronization and benchmark claims were not independently reproduced; no checkpoint installation or inference test was performed.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from the current discovery snapshot.
